representative_family_milestones.user_direction: Group work by major mod family. Reach one clear working example and proceed; do not exhaustively test sibling mods or variants.
representative_family_milestones.policy: A representative success establishes that handler/runtime path for the demonstrated context. Untested siblings use the same deterministic handler where their actual dependencies and format fit. Do not report every game or arbitrary Windows DLL as proven.
representative_family_milestones.asset_containers: Townfall Leon and third-person user-confirmed gameplay; no more redundant resolution-variant testing.
representative_family_milestones.ini: Install/game launch demonstrated; intended visual effect was not objectively established.
representative_family_milestones.ue4ss: Native startup and basic buffered Lua historical console proof; actual engine integration and Item Spawner remain unfinished.
representative_family_milestones.native_cpp: Genuine source C++ plugin packages locally as PRX; plugin in-game execution remains unfinished.
representative_family_milestones.windows_dll: No arbitrary Windows binary compatibility demonstrated.
representative_family_milestones.next_visible_milestone: Run original Item Spawner through reusable UE4SS runtime with an observable gameplay result.

typed_module_metadata.status: Source-only implementation and native compilation complete; no target execution.
typed_module_metadata.native_enumeration: Unavailable until list size units are evidenced; no native list API import or calls.
typed_module_metadata.limits: Typed metadata is not snapshot capture, current-game identity, mapping lifetime, permissions, engine ABI, callable pointers or hook capability.

immutable_scan_snapshot.status: Additive copied-snapshot resolver built and locally verified, independent review complete.
immutable_scan_snapshot.behavior: Actual retained resolver bodies scan immutable copied buffers labeled with original virtual addresses. Return module-relative candidate extents/access requirements plus scalar facts, never callable pointers. Original mapped-v1 guards unchanged.
immutable_scan_snapshot.limits: No live snapshot producer, original address dereference, engine ABI validation, call/hook provider or game execution. FName high-address constraints remain. Explicit bounded complete EH frame required with EH header.
immutable_scan_snapshot.review: Header-only EH metadata bound bypass found and fixed with red-to-green focused regression; no remaining material finding.

next_action: Continue production UE4SS game-context integration from typed_module_metadata and immutable_scan_snapshot. A public typed PS5 info declaration now exists and immutable snapshot scanning no longer requires copy-buffer addresses to equal original virtual addresses. Remaining are an evidenced module enumeration/count contract or known-handle source, consistent image capture/identity, actual engine/layout binding, and genuine live call/hook/game-thread delivery. Build source only where justified; do not manufacture these facts, repeat finished fixture wrappers or retry stopped native probing. One visible original Item Spawner success is the UE4SS family milestone; manual test waits for a real candidate.
